 Republican U.S. Rep. Jack Bergman has won reelection to Michigan's 1st Congressional District, securing another term representing Northern Michigan in Congress, according to the Associated Press.
 Bergman's victory keeps the district under Republican control.
 Michigan's 1st Congressional District covers the entire Upper Peninsula and much of the northern Lower Peninsula.
 Bergman will return to Washington for another two-year term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
 The Associated Press has called the race for Bergman. Official election results will be finalized through the canvassing and certification process.
